title: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
why_read: A template framework for building your own AI-curated 'daily hot topics' site, useful mainly as a starting point rather than a novel technical contribution.
analysis: This is a Chinese-language GitHub project describing itself as a framework for building a site that automatically finds trending topics and writes a daily digest, where you can swap in your own sources and curation criteria. It's essentially a templated pipeline combining scraping/aggregation with LLM-based summarization, aimed at anyone wanting their own niche 'hacker news'-style site. The high star count suggests strong interest, likely driven by its practical turnkey nature, but technically it's an application of well-established patterns (scraping plus LLM summarization) rather than a novel technique.
